summary:
Updated implementation plan incorporating:
1. Frosted dark glass header with backdrop-blur, subtle elevation, and distinct border separation against the page background.
2. Removal of bun.lock and permanent exclusion via .gitignore to prevent Cloudflare Pages deployment conflicts.
3. Complete removal of the mini 'OTAS | Ontario Tech Aerial Systems · Ontario Tech University' context text line across desktop and mobile.
4. Expanding the main 'Ontario Tech’s Drone Design Team.' headline horizontally across desktop view.
5. Positioning the animated drone as a compact interactive hero widget directly below the action buttons on mobile.
6. Adding a configurable 'Join Us' button in the top right linking to the recruitment Microsoft Form with a single-flag toggle in config.
7. Implementing the 3-tier sponsorship system (Ground Link $500–$999, Flight Path $1000–$2500, Mission Partner $2,500+) in a 3-card grid.
8. Condensing foundational needs into two focused modules (Monetary Sponsorship Funds vs In-Kind Equipment & Resources).
9. Adding dual sponsorship action links (Ontario Tech official clubs portal & direct email with one-click clipboard copy).
